title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theatre on 1978-11-24
lineage: Fresh master reel transfer and mastering for broadcast by Jim Blackwood Studer A807 playback of Pre-FM Master Reel (10in 7.5ips) > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X5 > Flac2496 Speed Correction by Jason Chastain Track, FLAC and Pack by Jamie Waddell
source: Recording info: PRE FM  > WBUF Reel Master engineered by David LaRussa

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear FM broadcast capture with booming drum mix, featuring standout Estimated, Shakedown Street and a rare standalone Fire on the Mountain.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the pristine sound of this FM‑broadcast source – the transfer is described as amazing, clean and professionally mastered, with an especially huge and defined drum presence. The performance itself is rated above‑par for 1978, highlighted by a curve‑ball second set that includes a strong Estimated, Shakedown Street and a rare Fire on the Mountain without Scarlet Begonias.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5‑star ratings and praise both the musical performance and the high‑fidelity recording; limited to two reviews, confidence is medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, crisp FM broadcast feed with a professional master; huge, clear drum mix and overall high‑fidelity sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as solid/standard; second set brings curveballs and rare moments, keeping the energy high.

band_member_comments.Drums: Drum sound is highlighted as huge, clear and exceptionally mixed, showcasing the band's 1977‑78 drum clarity.
